races.paceDynamic: Installment and Butterfly Mountain will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners ensuring a genuine gallop from the start. The pace should be honest rather than excessive given only two dedicated pace-setters in a 17-runner field. Mid-race, the tempo will likely sustain as the large field stretches out over Kilbeggan's testing hurdles track. This sustained gallop will punish hold-up horses trying to close from too far back, clearly favouring prominent runners and those who can track the early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Grind
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters maintain a steady gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: The honest tempo suits horses with proven stamina who can sit close early and find more late. Prominent racers avoid the traffic problems that will hamper hold-up horses in this big field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Installment and Butterfly Mountain go too fast early and fade
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start, allowing hold-up horses to close the gap and finish strongly. Those with tactical speed who stayed off the early pace can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and multiple fallers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and many chances compromised. Horses who avoid trouble and have alert jockeys can emerge from chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets an uncontested lead while the other struggles
scenarios.body: The loose leader steals crucial lengths and the field cannot close the gap. Front-running tactics prove decisive with the winner never headed.

races.paceDynamic: Shinnhill is the only confirmed front runner and will set his own tempo without early pressure. Seven horses want prominent positions including Long Gone, Kasper Hauser, Must Meet Cecil, Malbay Madness, Premier Rogue, Bhean Saibhre and Mister Vic - this creates serious traffic dangers approaching the business end. The hold-up brigade of Dairy Force, Centreofattention, Metamorpheus, Katherine, High Notions, Dontgowithjoe, Fort Randall and Desert Cave will benefit from this congestion as they can pick their way through. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and time their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates traffic problems 2-3 out as expected
scenarios.body: The seven horses fighting for prominent positions will compromise each other's chances while Shinnhill burns out after setting his own tempo. This allows the patient hold-up horses with tactical speed to sweep past the stalled leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent breaks clear
scenarios.trigger: If one or two from the prominent group can secure clean runs approaching the turn
scenarios.body: Malbay Madness or Bhean Saibhre could use their class to break free from the congested pack before traffic becomes terminal. They would then hold off the hold-up challenge with their earlier positional advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shinnhill wires field
scenarios.trigger: If the uncontested leader gets away with soft fractions and finds extra stamina
scenarios.body: With no early pace pressure, Shinnhill could steal crucial lengths and prove tough to peg back despite his modest recent form. The prominent pack's traffic problems would play into his hands by delaying their challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos benefits outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: Multiple fallers or a crawling pace could turn this into a lottery where the most unexposed or freshest horse from the rear prevails. Desert Cave or Katherine could emerge from the mayhem with their hold-up styles.

watchPoints.text: Watch for multiple fallers or mistakes in the prominent pack of seven horses as they bunch up approaching 2 out
Monitor Shinnhill's fractions early as he could steal the race if allowed soft sectionals with no pace pressure
Keep an eye on the Bolger/Walsh combination with Centreofattention returning fresh after 160 days
Watch for traffic problems to develop from halfway as Long Gone, Kasper Hauser and Must Meet Cecil converge
Note which hold-up horses get the clearest runs from the back as Dairy Force and Metamorpheus look best positioned

races.paceDynamic: Ottoman Style will likely dictate from the front with Ceanndana and Faceman providing early company, but neither will pressure aggressively given their prominent rather than pure lead styles. The moderate pace will allow the large field of hold-up horses - Digby, Mordor, Zam Bobbler, Mystic Malina, Ad Caelum and Ringdufferin - to stay in touch throughout the 3m journey. With no genuine speed merchants to create a strong gallop, this shapes as a tactical affair where positioning and stamina reserves become crucial in the closing stages. This race setup clearly favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can quicken from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Ottoman Style unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Mordor, Ad Caelum and Digby will prove decisive as they have reserves to quicken when others tire. The lack of early pace allows them to position perfectly for their preferred late rally.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Ottoman Style gets an uncontested lead and Ceanndana tracks him throughout
scenarios.body: Ottoman Style's stamina holds up under minimal pressure while Ceanndana's class tells in a straight fight. The moderate gallop suits their styles perfectly for a front-running finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Faceman and Ceanndana position aggressively to press Ottoman Style earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This creates enough pace to stretch the field but not enough to stop the prominent runners from lasting home. Faceman's recent win gives him confidence to challenge strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Ottoman Style goes too slow and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where any horse can win from anywhere. Form and class become secondary to traffic luck and positioning in a cavalry charge finale.

watchPoints.text: Ottoman Style must be monitored early - if he goes too slowly or gets headed, the entire pace complexion changes dramatically
Watch Mordor's jumping rhythm throughout as any mistake could compromise his hold-up tactics in a moderate pace scenario
Ceanndana's fitness levels after 195 days off will become apparent in the final half-mile when the race intensifies
Digby's positioning under inexperienced claimer Alix Balfe is crucial - getting too far back in a slowly-run race could prove fatal
Monitor the pace through the middle stages - if it quickens unexpectedly, several hold-up horses could be caught out of their ground

races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Arizona is the only confirmed front runner and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate terms at a comfortable gallop. The prominently raced Following Orders, Kate Knows Best, Strange Currency, Drop A Threat, Jerisk Star and Warriors Wood will track closely but none are aggressive pace pressers. This creates a moderate tempo that will quicken significantly from the second last fence as the large field of hold-up horses including In The Trenches, Better Times, Gunnery Sergeant, Shellrunforbriggs and Rockstown Girl all converge. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses with finishing speed who can benefit from the solid gallop and time their challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Arizona sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched
scenarios.body: The pace will be genuine but not punishing, allowing the back markers to close strongly up the hill with fresh legs. Class hold-up horses like In The Trenches, Shellrunforbriggs and Better Times get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Following Orders or Warriors Wood apply more pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field earlier and favour those positioned handy who can kick from the second last. Warriors Wood's recent winning form and Following Orders' consistency make them prime beneficiaries of this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Phoenix Arizona Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and Phoenix Arizona retains enough energy
scenarios.body: The leader gets an armchair ride and has enough left to resist the late charge up Kilbeggan's testing hill. His recent placed efforts suggest he can handle this tactical scenario with the right ride.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Arizona goes too slow and the race becomes a crawling sprint
scenarios.body: The race turns into a mad dash from the home turn favouring the quickest finishers regardless of position. This chaotic finish could produce a surprise result from the back of the field.

races.paceDynamic: Marv Michael stands as the lone confirmed front runner in this 17-runner handicap chase, likely to dictate terms from the front without early pressure. The prominent runners Milan Forth, Park That, Lisleigh Lad, Champagne Mahler and Nas Na Riogh will settle close behind, but none are habitual pace-pressers. With 11 hold-up horses including Cave Court, A Wave Of The Sea, Littlefoot and Pray Tell, this creates a bunched field tracking a sustainable gallop before a cavalry charge up the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the finish kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Marv Michael sets uncontested fractions allowing the back markers to close
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks. Cave Court, Littlefoot, A Wave Of The Sea and Pray Tell can all produce their best from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Milan Forth or Park That can secure ideal tracking positions behind Marv Michael
scenarios.body: These two prominent runners avoid the traffic problems that could engulf the hold-up brigade. Milan Forth's class edge or Park That's Bolger training could prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Marv Michael gets soft fractions and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: Despite being off the track for 230 days, his class and lack of early pressure creates perfect conditions. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on ground that's riding slower than ideal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Complete chaos in the straight with 17 runners bunched and looking for racing room. The handiest horse on the day regardless of running style could prevail through sheer luck and positioning.
